abstract: The patient was a 37-year-old man with superior mediastinal seminoma, which invaded the bilateral brachiocephalic vein, superior vena cava, pericardium and left lung. These invaded organs were resected with the tumor and a vascular reconstruction was performed with EPTFE graft and pericardial patch. EPTFE graft was interposed between the left brachiocephalic vein and right atrium. Superior vena cava was reconstructed by means of pericardial patch. Histologically, the tumor was diagnosed as pure seminoma. He received the prophylactic irradiation (45 Gy). Although venography two years after operation demonstrated the obstruction of the EPTFE graft and marked stenosis of the pericardial patch, the patient remains free from the symptom and is doing well without recurrence 45 months after operation.
abstract_ja: 患者は37歳男性。両側腕頭静脈、上大静脈、心膜、左肺に浸潤した上縦隔セミノーマであった。浸潤臓器は腫瘍とともに切除し、ePTFE人工血管と心膜パッチを用いて血管再建を行った。ePTFE人工血管は左腕頭静脈と右心房の間に挿入した。上大静脈は心膜パッチで再建した。組織学的に腫瘍は純粋セミノーマと診断された。予防的照射（45 Gy）を施行した。術後2年の静脈造影ではePTFE人工血管の閉塞と心膜パッチの高度狭窄が示されたが、患者は症状なく経過し、術後45か月の時点で再発なく良好に経過している。
